Proposition
[Covering spaces realizing arbitrary subgroups]

↗ prop:universal-cover-construction

1. ch1:1.36\group Covering Spaces

Under the hypotheses of section 3, every subgroup $H\subset \pi _1(X,x_0)$ is the image of $\pi _1(X_H,\widetilde x_0)$ for some covering $X_H\to X$.

Proof

\sketch On the universal cover identify path classes with the same endpoint when their concatenated loop represents an element of $H$. The quotient inherits evenly covered basic neighborhoods, and a loop lifts closed exactly when its class lies in $H$.

□
